description: Findlay parts counter pay plans on file - plan terms only. Employee names, signatures and employee numbers intentionally removed; do not add them.
requested_for: Subaru Las Vegas fixed ops director (example pay plans)
selection: One current parts counter plan from each of the top 10 stores by Jan-Oct 2026 parts gross (Qlik Productivity, PL_Line 'Total Gross Profit - Parts'), excluding Subaru LV. Chevrolet LV has two plans (A, B).

estimate_formulas.lr: max(draw, 1.6% x gross + tier% x gross; tiers 300K/330K/350K/375K = 0.10/0.20/0.30/0.40%)
estimate_formulas.nissan: base + 2.0% x gross + tier% x gross; tiers 160K/180K/200K = 0.25/0.50/0.75%

proration_clause_text: To ensure consistency and compliance, certain forms of compensation, including but not limited to salary, commissions, bonuses, Spiffs and/or car allowance, may be prorated based on the employees' actual days worked within a given month or pay period. Proration calculations will be based on company-defined workdays and applicable pay periods. This policy applies regardless of compensation type unless otherwise expressly stated in the employee's approved pay plan.
withholding_clause_text: All payments will be subject to statutory payroll withholdings. Upon the cessation of employment with the Company for any reason, the employee will receive payment for any compensation earned prior to that date, less any permissible offsets or deductions.

pay_structures.stores: Toyota Henderson, Honda Henderson, Cadillac, Honda Centennial Hills, Toyota Spokane, Kia LV, Nissan Henderson
pay_structures.range: Salary $1,000-$3,500/mo; commission 0.50%-2.0% of total parts gross
pay_structures.how_it_works: Fixed monthly salary plus a percentage of the whole parts department's gross. Rate tends to drop as salary rises.
pay_structures.strengths: Simple; rewards the whole team for department results; predictable floor.
pay_structures.watch_outs: No link to the individual's own production; pay rises with volume whether or not the person drives it.

pay_structures.how_it_works: Recoverable draw paid month-end; commission less the draw paid the 15th of the following month.
pay_structures.strengths: Fully commission-based; cost moves with gross.
pay_structures.watch_outs: Shortfall months carry forward; less income stability for the employee.

pay_structures.range: Extra 0.10%-0.75% of total gross once monthly gross passes a threshold ($160K Nissan; $300K Land Rover)
pay_structures.how_it_works: Non-cumulative tiers: the tier reached sets the extra % on the full gross.
pay_structures.strengths: Pays for hitting stretch department goals.
pay_structures.watch_outs: Thresholds must be sized to the store; a cliff at each tier.

pay_structures.stores: Audi Henderson (5.3% of individual sales), Chevrolet LV Plan B (flat $500-$1,250 on individual gross)
pay_structures.how_it_works: Pays on what the person personally sells, from CDK RBE by Employee or vAuto.
pay_structures.strengths: Directly rewards individual effort; separates top and low performers.
pay_structures.watch_outs: Needs clean employee attribution in the DMS; can create competition for tickets.

pay_structures.stores: Chevrolet LV Plans A and B (since 10/25/2026)
pay_structures.how_it_works: Paid on ADP timecard hours; bonus layered on top (shop hours or individual gross).
pay_structures.strengths: Clear hourly cost; overtime rules apply cleanly.
pay_structures.watch_outs: Weaker tie to gross unless a bonus is attached.

pay_structures.range: CSI $75-$200; shop hours $0.15-$0.17/hr; YoY growth $200-$250; car allowance $250-$300
pay_structures.how_it_works: Small flat amounts tied to CSI, shop hours sold, year-over-year growth, or vehicle ownership.
pay_structures.strengths: Ties parts staff to service volume and customer experience.
pay_structures.watch_outs: Adds admin; amounts are small relative to commission.
